summary: Iteration 32 (Semantic Memory Search) fully validated. Ran existing regression (test_iteration32_semantic.py: 2/2) + wrote new coverage (test_iteration32_semantic_extra.py: 6/6, 1 skipped roadmap). Verified UI on /library via Playwright: library-root, semantic-status, library-search all render; rebuild-index correctly hidden when no provider; Enter key triggers POST /api/memory/search (not old /api/archive?q=). All shape/fallback expectations met.
coverage_verified: GET /api/memory/search/status returns {has_provider:false, embedded:0, model:null, total_entries:N} when no provider
GET /api/memory/search/status returns full provider shape (has_provider:true, base_url, model, total_entries, embedded, pending) after PUT /api/providers
POST /api/memory/search/embed → 400 with 'No embeddings provider configured...' when no provider; {ok:true, queued:true} when configured
POST /api/memory/search/embed/sync → 400 when no provider; {embedded:N, skipped:M} when configured (3 embedded then 0 on idempotent re-run)
POST /api/memory/search → mode:'keyword', reason:'no_provider' fallback returns regex matches when no provider
POST /api/memory/search → mode:'keyword', reason:'no_index' when provider configured but no vectors stored (verified with in-process fake embeddings server)
POST /api/memory/search → mode:'semantic' returns correctly ranked results (e-dad, e-mom, e-work) via fake OpenAI-compatible embeddings server
twin_tools.exec_search_archive keyword path — /api/twin/start + /api/twin/message contract validated (status not 5xx)

Library.jsx UI: data-testid='library-root', 'semantic-status', 'library-search' all rendered. rebuild-index correctly hidden when no provider. Ribbon shows 'semantic search off · set up a local embeddings provider' with /settings link. Enter key press triggers POST /api/memory/search (network intercepted).
critical_code_review_comments: services.embeddings.get_config / has_provider / embed_texts pattern is clean and provider-agnostic.
MIN_SCORE=0.20 threshold plus graceful fallback (no_provider → embed_failed → no_index → no_matches) is well-tiered.
semantic_lookup wraps HTTPException + generic Exception so twin_tools never crashes if provider throws — good defensive design.
Small suggestion (non-blocking): SemSearchReq.query max_length=2000 could truncate silently on very long user queries. Consider trimming with a friendly 4xx message instead.
test_credentials: Created ephemeral users via mongosh recipe from /app/memory/test_credentials.md; all cleaned up in finally blocks / post-run.
seed_data_creation: Each test creates its own pytest-sem2-* user + entries + optional user_providers, then deletes all in finally blocks. UI test used mongosh-seeded user + 1 archive entry, cleaned up after.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Semantic search Session D fully green. The two new tests use an in-process fake OpenAI-embeddings HTTPServer on random port — reuse pattern for any future embed-related tests. UI Enter-key path is /api/memory/search (not /api/archive?q=). Rebuild-index button is intentionally conditional on has_provider.
